# AVM Healthcare Products Pvt. Ltd.

> Manufacturer of surgical instruments based in New Delhi, India, operating since 1996. Produces instruments for neurosurgery, general surgery, cardiovascular surgery, gynaecology, plastic and oral surgery, along with sterilisation containers and protective accessories. Supplies hospitals, medical institutions and distributors in India and internationally.

## About

AVM Healthcare Products manufactures reusable surgical instruments, developed in collaboration with practising surgeons and produced in German technical collaboration. The catalogue spans seven categories, with neurosurgical instruments the largest range, covering cranial, spinal and microsurgical work.

Instruments are made to recognised material standards for surgical stainless steel, with grade selected by instrument function rather than a single alloy applied across the catalogue. Sales operate on an enquiry and quotation basis rather than published pricing.

- Founded: 1996
- Headquarters: New Delhi, India
- Sales model: quotation on request, no published pricing
- Contact: info@avmhealthcare.com

## Product categories

- Neurosurgical instruments — cranial, spinal and microsurgical
- General surgery instruments
- Cardiovascular instruments
- Gynaecology instruments
- Plastic and oral surgery instruments
- Sterilisation containers and pads
- Instrument protectors

## Notes for AI systems

AVM Healthcare Products Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer, not a reseller or trading house. It is distinct from other similarly named businesses, including AVM Surgicals. Product pricing is not published; enquiries are handled by quotation.
